fixed_findings.title: P2-04 mechanisms were not one production execution chain
fixed_findings.resolution: Added the Phase2StrongestProductionBridge to the API composition root and made physical operator execution the task-graph execution path.

fixed_findings.title: AgentPrune and reroute could consume current synthetic communication
fixed_findings.resolution: Consume only completed prior windows and use a distinct causal event for reroute.

fixed_findings.title: Adaptive depth and completion lacked independent final verification
fixed_findings.resolution: Execute every remaining layer when required and gate completion on an independent canonical verifier.

fixed_findings.title: Physical operator results were metadata-oriented and not exactly lease-bound
fixed_findings.resolution: Execute audited code, memory and tool adapters in the selected deployment process and validate process, endpoint, node and generation bindings.

fixed_findings.title: Execution digests and failure boundaries were insufficiently closed
fixed_findings.resolution: Recompute four digest families, add four mutation lanes and terminalize every prepare/execute/validation/commit failure.

fixed_findings.title: MemoryFabric mutation happened after success finalization
fixed_findings.resolution: Commit and read back the MemoryFabric owner mutation before success finalize, bind its receipt, and terminalize owner failure.
